name: Juniper’s Gin Bar
limitations: Current official visit and event information, with a separate public community impression; no on-site audit. Doorway width, entrance steps, parking-to-door route, table clearances and toilet layout remain unverified. The absence of changing tables is stated in the venue’s family-amenities guidance, which does not describe adult changing equipment separately. A lounge reservation does not guarantee a quiet space or suitable seating; live music and changing layouts may affect a visit.
facts: The homepage advertises live jazz on Fridays and Saturdays from 8–11 p.m. Check the calendar before choosing a visit time; this is not a quiet-hours promise.
The reservations page links to Resy and directs parties larger than 16 to its event-booking page. Confirm seating requirements with the venue before booking.
Book your Juniper's Gin and Tapas reservation on Resy
Juniper’s says guests under 21 are welcome for a meal, but it does not offer high chairs, changing tables or children’s menus. This statement appears in its event page’s family-amenities guidance.
Guests under 21 are welcome for a meal, but we don’t offer high chairs, changing tables, or children’s menus.
Lounge reservations for groups of 17–50 provide dedicated space while the bar remains open to the public. They do not provide exclusive use of the venue.
For groups of 17–50, our lounge reservations offer dedicated space to celebrate, enjoy cocktails, and share small bites while the bar remains open to the public.
The venue lists (859) 291-4466 for advance questions. Entrance, toilet and seating arrangements need direct confirmation.

The posted schedule closes Monday and Tuesday. Wednesday and Thursday open at 4 p.m. with the kitchen closing at 9 p.m.; Friday and Saturday run 4 p.m.–midnight with the kitchen closing at 10 p.m. Sunday brunch is 10 a.m.–2 p.m. and bar service 2–9 p.m. Recheck before travel.
